item.tib: theg pa chen po gsang bas brgyand pa'i yi ge
item.note: Titles and numbers of the chapters are given at the beginning of chap. 1 and at the end of the other chapters; chap. 2 is indicated as le'u lhag ma; in all the other cases the numbers are in the form of cardinal numerals: theg pa chen po gsang bas rgyand pa'i chos kyi yi ge le'u gcig / sum / bzhi ... ste | ... le'u 'o.
